item.title: The birthday coupons
item.description:
One of the things I enjoy the most of living in the States, is that almost every business has some sort of rewards program. Particularly after COVID-19, I feel like more and more businesses are trying to find a way to push you to come back to their stores and spend some money.

I usually store all my pictures on the cloud, so the only reason I look for more space when I buy a new phone is because I like to download restaurants apps. I think I have them all, even the ones from other states.

item.title: The McDonald's App
item.description:
One of the things I never realized before watching the movie “The Founder”, is that you can find as many McDonald’s restaurants, as you can find churches in the States. There is even a line in the movie that refers to this very specifically:

[to Dick and Mac]
Ray Kroc: McDonald’s can be the new American church, and it ain’t just open on Sundays, boys.

It doesn’t matter where you are located in the USA, you will find a McDonald’s near by, and the best part is that they have the same menu everywhere. To me that’s the key to their business: consistency.

item.title: Feng's Kitchen
item.description:
Sometimes I feel like I need more vegetables in my diet. Living here in the States it’s kind of hard to find vegetables when you are looking at fast food or even at local owned restaurants. And I think this is why people google things like: “is potato a vegetable?” (the answer is yes, I googled it myself).

After a few years living here I found that the solution to this problem is Asian restaurants, and more specifically, Chinese restaurants. You can find Chinese restaurants everywhere, even in the smallest towns/cities/villages.
